records.text: Milo Yiannopoulos said the moment Trump denied there were Epstein files and told supporters to stop asking about them was the moment Trumpism died.
records.speaker: Milo Yiannopoulos

appearances.snippet: But when he said there's no Epstein files and then ... The Democrats made it up. And then, stop asking. And then, if you're asking, you're not a fan of mine. And then, if you're asking, I don't want you. ... That is the moment Trumpism died.

verification.notes: The source-scoped transcript context identifies Milo Yiannopoulos as the speaker and preserves the sequence: he characterized Trump's position as saying there were no Epstein files, that Democrats made them up, and that supporters should stop asking, then said this was the moment Trumpism died. This verifies the attributed opinion and its meaning; the judgment that Trumpism died is subjective and is not treated as an independently measurable fact.
